heading: ### Round-21 gate/probe registry — finite environment differential

findings.why: The rev abbreviation is glued to the preceding word (`unchanged from33d03b7` for `unchanged from 33d03b7`), a run-together token of the QUALITY-104 class.

The flag default is glued to its value; every other mention in SKILL.md keeps `max-share` a separate token (`grep -oE 'max-share[^ ]{0,10}'` returns 2x `max-share`, 1x `max-share,`, and only this 1x `max-share0.40`).
Missing space between `selftest` and the exit arm `0`, although the round-20 row 27 lines above writes the same cell as `selftest 0 clean/1 failed`.
Missing space between the article and the count (`the199-entry` for `the 199-entry`), a run-together token of the QUALITY-104 class.
Missing space between the verb and the source row id, while the same section writes `mined S079` and `mined S084/S085`.
Missing space between the verb and the count (`cover16` for `cover 16`), a run-together token of the QUALITY-104 class.
Missing space between `is` and the verdict token (`is1/TOTAL_MISMATCH` for `is 1/TOTAL_MISMATCH`).
Missing space between `exits` and the code (`exits0` for `exits 0`), a run-together token of the QUALITY-104 class.
Missing space between the verb and the source row id, inconsistent with `mined S079` earlier in the same section.
Missing space between `including` and the count (`including62/62` for `including 62/62`).
Missing space between `expected` and the verdict token (`expected1/ARGV_MISMATCH` for `expected 1/ARGV_MISMATCH`).
